title: Release engineering weekly notes 2026-04-07
content:
Release Engineering — Weekly Notes (2026-04-07)
Attendees: Asha Patel (owner), Miguel Santos, Rina Kapoor, Evan Liu, Samir Rao, + on-call rota representatives
Meeting length: 45m

Quick summary:
- Mainline release train for 2026-04-09 proceeding as scheduled.
- Hotfix RE-1289 (KV-cache OOM under 4k sequences) targeted for immediate roll forward; patch validated in staging.
- Change log draft for 2026-04-09 release ready; callout for kernel selector change that impacts older quantized models.
- Two rollout/blockers: canary lag on eu-west-1, and a flaky integration test (infra-autoscaler smoke) causing false negatives.

Agenda and notes:
1) Release train status (2026-04-09 weekly train)
   - Release lead: Asha Patel. Train cut tomorrow 06:00 UTC; deploy window 08:00–10:00 UTC.
   - Shiplist highlights: runtime v3.14.0 (kernel selector improvements), autoscaler adjustments, dashboard tracing hook for rollout metrics.
   - Targeted customers for canary: 5% hosted API traffic, dedicated beta customers opt-in.
   - Rollout policy: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m observation windows and automated rollback on error rate > 1.5x baseline.
   - Canary metrics to watch: 99th percentile latency, error rate, token throughput, memory usage on GPU nodes.

2) Hotfixes and urgent patches
   - RE-1289 (KV cache OOM) — created by Miguel. Patch applied to staging and prod-smoke namespace.
     - Status: hotfix branch merged to main, build #704 deployed to staging, integration smoke tests passed.
     - Prod deployment plan: staggered canary starting at 02:00 UTC tomorrow, limited to CPU-bound nodes first.
     - Rollback plan: Revert to runtime v3.13.2 and disable prefix/KV caching for affected models.
     - Owner for prod push: Miguel Santos.
   - RE-1292 (security: dependency bump for openssl on builder image) — low-risk, included in train but also flagged for a separate rolling update if any post-deploy signs of instability appear.

3) Change log and release notes (draft)
   - Highlights to include in user-facing notes:
     * Improved kernel selection logic — expected ~12% median latency reduction on gpus with Ampere+ when sequence length < 1024.
     * Autoscaler: smoother ramp-up for Dedication pools, fixes for flapping under bursty workloads.
     * Hotfix: KV-cache OOM mitigation for long contexts (RE-1289).
   - Internal breaking change notice: Quantization path fallback behavior changed; older 4-bit quantized models may see different perf characteristics. Engineering docs and migration notes linked.
   - Action: Rina to finalize changelog bullets and submit to marketing by 2026-04-08 17:00 UTC.

4) Blockers and risks
   - Canary lag in eu-west-1: Observed 15–40s increase in canary rollout step time due to control plane throttling.
     - Temporary mitigation: throttle canary growth and increase observation window for eu-west-1.
     - Action: Evan to follow up with infra team to increase rate limits and trace control plane latencies; ticket created JIRA:RE-1298.
   - Flaky infra-autoscaler integration test: Causes false failure signal in pre-prod, delaying promotion.
     - Action: Samir to quarantine flaky test and add a retry/delay gate. Test owner: infra QA.

5) Post-deploy validation checklist (owners assigned)
   - Observability dashboards: verify rollout traces, per-route latency breakdowns — Owner: Rina Kapoor.
   - Cost telemetry smoke: check token cost deltas and batching stats — Owner: Evan Liu.
   - SLO / Alert sanity: ensure error rate and latency alerts hold — Owner: On-call SRE.
   - Customer-facing status: draft message in case rollback needed — Owner: Customer Success on-call (Samir to coordinate).

6) Standup-style updates from team members
   - Miguel: Completed RE-1289 fix; staging validated. Will run prod canary tomorrow.
   - Rina: Changelog draft ready; need PR review. Working on dashboard widget for rollout traces.
   - Evan: Investigating eu-west-1 control plane throttle; increased logging in place. Also landed autoscaler smoothing patch.
   - Samir: Quarantined flaky test, added more logging; will create a separate patch to harden test by EOD.
   - Asha: Coordinating train cut and on-call rotation; final release checklist prepared.

7) Action items (owners and due dates)
   - Miguel: Push RE-1289 to prod canary (2026-04-08 02:00 UTC).
   - Rina: Finalize release notes + marketing PR (2026-04-08 17:00 UTC).
   - Evan: Follow up with infra on eu-west-1 rate limit and remediation (JIRA:RE-1298) (2026-04-08).
   - Samir: Stabilize infra-autoscaler test, add retry gate (2026-04-09).
   - Asha: Execute train cut and coordinate on-call for early monitoring (2026-04-09 06:00 UTC).

Decisions made:
- Proceed with scheduled train 2026-04-09; include RE-1292 but monitor builder-image metrics closely.
- Hotfix RE-1289 accepted into train but will also be pushed as an emergency canary earlier as described.

Notes & Context (loose items):
- Reminder: update internal runbook for KV-cache degradation scenarios with the new OOM mitigation steps. Miguel to add runbook entry.
- Consider adding an automated gating rule that prevents canary growth in regions with control-plane latencies > 10s. Proposal to be drafted next week.

Appendix: Relevant links
- Runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/512
- JIRA:RE-1289 (KV-cache OOM) 
- Confluence: RELEASE-TRAIN-2026Q2 page for rollout calendar

Next meeting: 2026-04-14 09:00 UTC (same channel)

---
Notes prepared by Asha Patel on 2026-04-07. Last modified 2026-04-08 after integration test updates.
